readme:
# Walmart Product Page Returns structured data for one Walmart product page: name, price, availability, images, review count and seller details. It needs the full product page URL as `url`. ## Use cases - Track the listed price of a specific Walmart laptop or other item over time. - Check whether a product is in stock for a given store or zip code. - Identify which third-party seller is listing an item and link to their seller page. - Collect product names, descriptions and image URLs to build a catalog. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/walmart/scrape/product" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"url": "https://www.walmart.com/ip/HP-14-Laptop/17581855155"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `url` | string | Yes | Full Walmart page URL, e.g. https://www.walmart.com/ip/HP-14-Laptop/17581855155 | | `country` | string | No | Walmart marketplace country code, e.g. 'us', 'ca', 'mx' (default 'us'). | | `storeId` | string | No | Walmart store ID for localized inventory. | | `zipCode` | string | No | US zip code used to determine local product availability. | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "currency": "$", "description": "

Statement: Original Seal is opened for upgrade ONLY. If the computer has modi…", "price": "$599.99", "productAvailability": true, "productId": "17581855155", "productImages": [ "https://i5.walmartimages.com/seo/HP-14-Laptop-Student-Business-Computer-Intel-N1…" ], "productName": "HP 14\" Laptop Student Business Computer, Intel N150 Processor, 1-Year Microsoft …", "reviewCount": 115, "sellerId": "974611902A77437FBB999DF11CCBF0BA", "sellerName": "82days Tech", "sellerUrl": "https://www.walmart.com/global/seller/102594305", "soldCount": null } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `productId` | Walmart product ID. It matches the number at the end of the product page URL. | | `productName` | Full product title as shown on the page. | | `price` | Current price as a string with the currency symbol, for example `$599.99`. | | `currency` | Currency symbol used for the price. | | `productAvailability` | Boolean. `true` means the product is available for the requested location. | | `reviewCount` | Number of customer reviews for the product. | | `productImages[]` | List of product image URLs. | | `description` | Product description. It contains HTML markup and may be cut short. | | `sellerName / sellerId / sellerUrl` | Name, ID and Walmart page URL of the seller listing the product. | | `soldCount` | Units sold, when the page shows it. It is `null` when the page gives no value. | ## Notes - Copy the `url` from a Walmart product page. The product ID is the last part of the path, for example `17581855155`. - Use `country` to pick the marketplace, and use `storeId` or `zipCode` to localize availability. - To find product URLs first, call [Walmart Search](/apis/walmart/search). - To read customer reviews for the product, call [Walmart Product Reviews](/apis/walmart/product-reviews). ## Pricing $0.01 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization.
